sections.title: Letter Q
paragraphs: The name of this letter is (Q) /kjuː/. On its own, it sounds like (qat) /kæt/, which means a khat plant. This letter has one main sound when it stands alone. You almost always see it before another letter in words.

sections.title: Pronouncing the letter
paragraphs: Press the back of your tongue against the soft roof of your mouth. Stop the air for a brief moment. Release the air quickly with a small burst. Your voice stays off. Put your hand on your throat. You feel no shake when you make this sound.

sections.title: Spelling and sounds
paragraphs: This letter stands on its own without u only in rare borrowed words. It sounds like (qat) /kæt/. In another rare borrowed word, it sounds like (qi) /tʃiː/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not add an extra sound after it when it stands alone. Say the crisp sound in cat. Do not make this sound deep in your throat. Keep your tongue touch light and clean.
